findings.description: Planning permits have been filed to repair the deteriorating brick facade and parapet of One Ecker Place, the 1906 iron-framed brick warehouse at 16 Jessie Street built as an industrial investment property by William H. Crocker, founder of Crocker National Bank. Converted to offices in a 1972 design by Arthur Gensler and to residential use twenty years ago, it now holds 51 apartments over ground-floor retail; a 2007 historic review by Kelley & VerPlanck found it eligible for the California Register, though it has not been listed. Irvine-based Sehgal Revoc. Living Trust is the property owner.

extra.historic_review: Kelley & VerPlanck, 2007 — eligible for the California Register, not yet listed
